title: HOX code-based stratification reveals RUNX1T1-HDAC reprogramming as a targetable driver of lineage plasticity across cancers.
authors: Jiang, Yuyin; Cheng, Siyuan; Zhang, Catherine Yijia; Jin, Xiao; Li, Longjun; Shin, Ha Eun; Alrefai, Assma; Luo, Anfeng; Xu, Yaru; Kim, Isaac Yi; Mu, Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文利用HOX转录因子编码分层识别跨癌种谱系可塑性，并通过AI结构建模和CUT&RUN揭示RUNX1T1-HDAC3复合物重塑染色质机制，虽涉及TF-DNA调控但核心非TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作建模，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Cancer remains a leading cause of death worldwide, with lineage plasticity emerging as a hallmark that drives therapy resistance and tumor progression by enabling cancer cells to alter identity and evade targeted therapies. Although genomic and transcriptomic aberrations correlate with lineage plasticity, the absence of scalable cross-cancer markers to rapidly identify plastic subtypes has limited predictive utility. Homeobox (HOX) genes encode transcription factors that define tissue identity through distinct expression patterns, or HOX codes, within specific lineages. By analyzing multi-omics data encompassing 39 HOX genes across more than 80,000 RNA-seq samples across 23 cancer types spanning 114 cancer subtypes, we found that HOX code expression robustly stratifies lineage-constrained and lineage-plastic states at a cross-cancer level. This framework revealed previously unrecognized lineage-plastic subtypes in prostate cancer, lung cancer, and acute myeloid leukemia (AML), each displaying distinct HOX code divergence compared to non-plastic counterparts. Differential expression analysis across these representative malignancies identified RUNX1T1 as a consistent regulator associated with HOX-defined plastic states. We validated RUNX1T1 upregulation in bulk and single-cell RNA-seq from extensive preclinical and clinical cohorts and demonstrated that RUNX1T1 is functionally required for lineage-plastic programs in prostate cancer models. AI-based structural modeling and co-immunoprecipitation established the NCOR/HDAC3 complex as a critical binding partner of RUNX1T1. CUT&RUN profiling revealed that RUNX1T1 remodels chromatin by globally reducing active enhancer marks, thereby repressing lineage-defining differentiation programs and reshaping HOX positional identity. Selective pharmacologic inhibition of HDAC3 or targeted gene silencing via lipid nanoparticles suppressed the growth of lineage-plastic cancer cells, uncovering a therapeutically actionable vulnerability. Together, these findings establish RUNX1T1 as a cross-lineage regulator of HOX code-defined plasticity and identify the RUNX1T1-HDAC axis as a targetable mechanism underlying cancer lineage plasticity.
abstract_zh: 癌症仍然是全球范围内的主要死亡原因，其中谱系可塑性（lineage plasticity）作为一项标志性特征，通过使癌细胞改变身份并逃避免疫靶向治疗，驱动治疗耐药性和肿瘤进展。尽管基因组和转录组异常与谱系可塑性相关，但缺乏可扩展的跨癌种标志物来快速识别可塑性亚型，限制了其预测实用性。同源盒（Homeobox, HOX）基因编码转录因子，通过特定谱系内的独特表达模式（即HOX代码）定义组织身份。通过分析涵盖23种癌症类型、114种癌症亚型、超过80,000个RNA-seq样本的多组学数据，涉及39个HOX基因，我们发现HOX代码表达在跨癌种水平上稳健地将谱系受限状态和谱系可塑性状态分层。该框架揭示了前列腺癌、肺癌和急性髓系白血病（acute myeloid leukemia, AML）中此前未被识别的谱系可塑性亚型，每种亚型与非可塑性对应亚型相比，均表现出独特的HOX代码分歧。对这些代表性恶性肿瘤的差异表达分析确定了RUNX1T1作为与HOX定义的可塑性状态相关的一致调节因子。我们在广泛的临床前和临床队列中，通过批量RNA-seq和单细胞RNA-seq验证了RUNX1T1的上调，并证明RUNX1T1在前列腺癌模型中对谱系可塑性程序具有功能必要性。基于AI的结构建模和免疫共沉淀实验确定NCOR/HDAC3复合物为RUNX1T1的关键结合伙伴。CUT&RUN分析揭示RUNX1T1通过全局减少活性增强子标记来重塑染色质，从而抑制谱系定义的分化程序并重塑HOX位置身份。通过选择性药理学抑制HDAC3或脂质纳米颗粒介导的靶向基因沉默，可抑制谱系可塑性癌细胞的生长，揭示了一个治疗上可操作的脆弱性。综合来看，这些发现将RUNX1T1确立为HOX代码定义可塑性的跨谱系调节因子，并确定RUNX1T1-HDAC轴为癌症谱系可塑性背后的可靶向机制。
